idea-plugin.name: Azure Templates Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Azure Templates Navigator — full IDE support for Azure Pipelines YAML templates.

  • Hover any template: reference to see its parameters, types, defaults and allowed values
  • Go to declaration on templates, passed parameters, parameters.x and $(variables)
  • Completion for template paths, parameter names and allowed values
  • Validation + quick fixes: missing/unknown parameters (with "did you mean"), type mismatches, disallowed values, unused parameters, missing templates
  • Templates from other repositories (template: x.yml@alias) are downloaded automatically into a shared cache using your normal git credentials — no manual cloning
  • Find Usages, Call Hierarchy and a Code Vision "N usages" hint on templates and their parameters — see which pipelines use a template before you change it
  • Structure view of pipelines: stages, jobs, steps, template calls, ${{ if }} blocks and parameters
  • Dependencies tree, interactive template graph, project-wide diagnostics and repositories views

Powered by the same engine as the VS Code extension and the atn CLI, so behaviour is identical everywhere.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.0

  • New shared engine (also used by the VS Code extension and the atn CLI) — identical behaviour across IDEs
  • Templates referenced from other repositories are downloaded automatically (GitHub, Azure Repos, Bitbucket, GitHub Enterprise)
  • New checks: disallowed values, missing template files, unknown repository aliases, "did you mean" for misspelled parameters
  • Template path and allowed-value completion; hover on passed parameters and parameters.x
  • Search Template Parameters… (editor context menu) to filter long parameter lists and jump to a declaration
  • New Repositories tab; all views merged into one "Azure Templates" tool window
  • Requires IntelliJ 2024.2+ and the LSP4IJ plugin (installed automatically)
  • Native IntelliJ UI: Find Usages, Call Hierarchy, Code Vision usage counts, Structure view, gutter icons on template references, IntelliJ toolbar and menus in the graph, plain documentation popups
  • extends: templates are fully validated (parameters next to template: were previously ignored)
  • New check: ${{ parameters.x }} where x is not declared
